title: Support.
officialText:
Each handrail or guard section shall be supported by a minimum of three glass balusters or shall be otherwise
supported to remain in place should one baluster panel fail. Glass balusters shall not be installed without an attached handrail or
guard.
Exception: A top rail shall not be required where the glass balusters are laminated glass with two or more glass plies of
equal thickness and the same glass type when approved by the department. The panels shall be designed to withstand the
loads specified in Section 1607.7.
